rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for presenting something concisely or summarizing it in short.

example.traditional: 簡單咁講，呢個計劃行唔通。
example.jyutping: gaan2 daan1 gam2 gong2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 haang4 m4 tung1

rows.note: Use this for doing something or staying somewhere for a short time.

example.english: I’ll stay at the convenience store briefly.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 bin6 lei6 dim3 lau4 jat1 zan6 sin1
